Manage the Trace Storage Engine: view status, trigger flushes, inspect files.

Usage:
  trace tse [command]

Available Commands:
  config      View or modify TSE configuration
  flush       Trigger an immediate flush cycle
  inspect     List recent Parquet files in the manifest
  metrics     Show TSE metrics
  recover     Recover TSE from backup snapshot
  snapshot    Create a TSE snapshot
  status      Show TSE status

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for tse

Global Flags:
  -c, --config string   path to config file

Use "trace tse [command] --help" for more information about a command.
